methodologyNotes: Covers GPS/GNSS location trackers designed to be worn by dogs and sold at a published US price, including cellular trackers, sport radio tracking collars, and GPS virtual-fence containment collars. Excludes Bluetooth-only tags with no independent GPS (e.g. AirTag holders), indoor RFID pet doors, and buried-wire invisible fences with no satellite positioning. Price is top-level priceUsd: typical US MSRP for the device hardware in USD, excluding any subscription. connectivityType is an enum for how location reaches the owner: 'lte-cellular', 'radio-uhf' (direct handheld radio link), 'satellite', or 'bluetooth-cellular' (BLE local + cellular backhaul). positioningSystem is an enum of the satellite constellations used: 'gps', 'gps-glonass-galileo', or 'dual-band-gnss'. subscriptionRequired is a boolean: true when full location tracking needs a paid plan. monthlyFeeUsd is the cheapest published recurring plan in USD per month billed at the longest term; 0 when no subscription is required; null if undisclosed. batteryLifeDays is the manufacturer's maximum claimed battery life in days at the default tracking mode. liveUpdateIntervalSec is the fastest live/real-time location refresh interval in seconds. weightGrams is device weight in grams (tracker module only, excluding strap where separable). waterproofRating is the published IingressProtection code as a string (e.g. 'IP67', 'IP68'); null if the maker states only a vague 'waterproof' claim. rangeMiles is the maximum direct tracking range in miles for radio/handheld systems; null for cellular trackers with nationwide coverage and no fixed range. activityTracking is a boolean for built-in step/activity monitoring. healthMonitoring is a boolean for vital-sign or behavior health monitoring (heart rate, respiration, sleep, scratching). containmentFence is a boolean for GPS virtual-fence containment with an on-collar boundary correction (true) versus notify-only geofence alerts (false).

products.name: Tractive GPS DOG 6
products.priceNote: US device MSRP $79, hardware only (excludes subscription). Sourced from the Treeline Review tested review, which states "Price: $79 (device only)" and a comparison table row "Tractive Dog 6 Smart Dog Tracker … DEVICE MSRP … $79". The official Tractive product page lists price in EUR only (41,40 € sale / 69 € original), so the USD figure is taken from the US review.
products.provenance: The official Tractive product page (tractive.com/en/pd/gps-tracker-dog) lists the DOG 6 as a model distinct from the DOG 6 XL and gives its Technical Specs verbatim: Weight "39 g", size 71×29×17 mm, Battery "Up to 2 weeks", Waterproof "100% waterproof (IP68)", Connectivity "LTE/4G (Cat1bis)"/Bluetooth 5.0/WiFi, Location "GPS, GLONASS, Galileo", and LIVE updates "every 2-3 seconds"; it also confirms Activity Monitoring plus resting heart-rate/respiratory/sleep/scratch health monitoring, and a shock-free virtual fence that only sends escape alerts (notify-only, no on-collar correction → containmentFence false). The Treeline Review tested review corroborates the exact model "Tractive Dog 6" and supplies the US price, stating "Price: $79 (device only)" and a comparison table "DEVICE MSRP … $79", along with "Up to 14 days" battery, "IP68", "1.4 ounces", and live tracking "every 2-3 seconds". Subscription is required; Treeline lists USD plan totals "$120 billed annually / $168 billed every 2 years / $300 billed every 5 years", so the cheapest recurring rate at the longest term is $300 ÷ 60 months = $5/month (monthlyFeeUsd 5); rangeMiles is null because it is a cellular tracker with unlimited/nationwide range.

The technobark.com review (dated Feb 24, 2026, explicitly the "Series 3+ Model") corroborates the LTE-M cellular network, IP68 waterproofing, and that the collar cannot be bought without a subscription — "you actually pay for the subscription and the collar comes with it," plus a one-time $20 activation fee — so no standalone device-hardware MSRP excluding subscription is published, leaving priceUsd null. Retailer/review pricing reflects membership bundles (pawtechreview.com lists $189.00, matching Fi's 1-year prepaid plan), not a device-only price, and the cheapest per-month rate at the longest term is not published as a per-month figure, so monthlyFeeUsd is null; battery ("up to 3 months"), live update interval, and weight are not stated in the units the methodology requires, so they are left null.
